Meeting: EMEA Contract Legal Review
Date: 2026-04-21
Participants: James B. (CEO), Rachel V. (Head of Legal)

---

James: Rachel, thanks for joining. I wanted to touch base on the EMEA partnership agreement before we proceed with the commercial team.

Rachel: Of course. I've reviewed the first two sections — the partnership structure and exclusivity clauses look fine. The main area I still need to work through is the revenue share model and the indemnity provisions. Those are the sections that carry the most risk.

James: How long do you need to complete the full review?

Rachel: If I have everything I need, I can have the full EMEA contract review completed and back to you by May 1st.

James: That works. Is there anything on our side you're waiting for?

Rachel: Yes, actually. I need the final financial appendix — the one that shows the projected revenue split by market. Without that I can't sign off on the revenue share provisions.

James: Of course. I'll make sure you have the financial appendix by Wednesday so you have everything you need for the full review.

Rachel: Perfect. Once I have that I can move straight into the risk sections.

James: And do you anticipate any deal-breaker clauses?

Rachel: I'd rather not speculate until I've read it all, but the indemnity cap looks low based on deal size. I may come back to you with a recommendation to push back on that.

James: Understood. Let's connect again once you've completed the review. Same time next week?

Rachel: That works.
